mainEntity.name: How many modules does the Masterstroke Academy blockchain course have?

acceptedAnswer.text: 21 modules across 4 phases, with 123 submodules and 130+ hours of content. Phase 1 has 4 modules (~18 hours), Phase 2 has 4 modules (~20 hours), Phase 3 has 9 modules (~70 hours), and Phase 4 has 4 modules (~22 hours).

mainEntity.name: What Solidity and Web3 topics does the curriculum cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: The curriculum covers cryptography fundamentals, EVM architecture, Solidity smart contracts, Hardhat, Web3.js, DeFi protocols, NFTs, DAOs, ZK Proofs, RWA tokenisation, smart contract security auditing, and capstone dApp deployment on MST Chain.

mainEntity.name: What is the assessment pass rate to unlock the next lesson?

acceptedAnswer.text: You must score at least 70% on each submodule assessment to unlock the next lesson. Assessments include MCQs, coding challenges with testnet deployment, descriptive questions, projects, and presentations.

mainEntity.name: What certificate do I get on completing the blockchain course?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive a verifiable on-chain certificate recorded on MST Blockchain - one of the first blockchain-native developer certificates in India.

mainEntity.name: Can I get funding after completing the course?

acceptedAnswer.text: Top capstone projects presented at Demo Day are eligible for MST ecosystem grants of up to $50,000 USD to launch their startup MVP.
